title: Botanical Survey Of India
definition: The Botanical Survey of India (BSI) is the apex research organization under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), mandated for taxonomic and floristic studies of wild plant resources of India.
importanceInUpsc: BSI is critical for questions related to biodiversity conservation, environmental governance, and institutional frameworks in India. It frequently appears in Prelims regarding its mandate, publications, and role in the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Botanical Survey Of India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
